scope: 19 remaining captured UCSD computing-adjacent candidates; all posting text read and visa/work-authorization terms checked.
deadlinePolicy: Explicit final cutoff stored as deadline with rolling=false; review dates retained separately or in summaries so postings do not stay active past hard cutoff.

after.title: Assistant Professor of Computational and Experimental Molecular Biology
after.summary: Tenure-track molecular biology search combining computational and experimental research, including bioinformatics and AI/ML genomic analysis; requires a biology or related PhD and relevant research publications. October 9 review has passed; final cutoff June 30, 2027.

after.title: Assistant Professor in Cognitive Science
after.summary: Computational cognitive science search studying biological or artificial minds and intelligences; applicants need a relevant cognitive-science doctorate or ABD status, with degree completed by appointment. Full consideration November 9, 2026; final cutoff May 1, 2027.

after.title: Assistant Professor in High-level Human Cognition
after.summary: High-level human cognition research connecting experiments with formal/computational theories; requires a psychology, cognitive science, decision science or closely related PhD/ABD focused on this specialty, completed by appointment. Anticipated start July 1, 2027; October 9 review has passed and final cutoff is May 1, 2027.

after.department: Office of Research and Innovation — Organized Research Units
after.title: Assistant, Associate, or Full Project Scientist/s (2026) Organized Research Units (Multi)
after.summary: Non-tenured academic project-scientist pool across organized research units, explicitly accepting computer science and other relevant terminal degrees; applicants select a specialization unit and contribute to supervised research without formal teaching duties. Appointment depends on project funding and duration; October 5 review has passed, final cutoff February 28, 2027.

after.title: Assistant Professor (Tenure Track)
after.summary: Nanosensing, wearables and healthcare diagnostics search explicitly including AI/ML and digital health; requires a chemical/nanoengineering, materials science, bioengineering or closely related PhD by appointment. Portal review date October 31 conflicts with November 30 full-consideration wording in the description; final cutoff May 31, 2027.

after.title: Assistant Project Scientist
after.summary: Research on AI for bioprinting, DLP-based 3D bioprinter hardware/software and bioreactors; requires an ECE, bioengineering or related PhD plus relevant bioprinting and ML experience. Full consideration October 21, 2026; final cutoff February 6, 2027.

after.title: Assistant Project Scientist
after.summary: Part-time (25% effort) academic research role using R/Python and spatial data science to model land use, transport and emissions for a California Air Resources Board project; requires a data science, statistics, planning, policy or related doctorate. Full consideration October 23, 2026; final cutoff October 5, 2027.

after.title: Assistant, Associate or Full Research Scientist
after.summary: Non-tenured research-scientist search in computational or engineering disciplines; requires a computational, engineering or closely related PhD, with independent research, extramural funding and publications expected. Appointment depends on project funding and duration; September 4 review has passed, final cutoff December 31, 2026.

after.title: Associate/Full Research Scientist
after.summary: Research-scientist search in remote sensing, mapping, modeling, multimodal digital documentation and digital twin synthesis; requires a relevant doctorate and independent scholarly impact, with grant development and publications expected. June 21 review has passed; final cutoff May 7, 2027.

after.title: Adjunct Professor Series in Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering (26-27 AY)
after.summary: Non-tenure-track adjunct pool combining research, teaching and service, with robotics among named areas; requires a mechanical/aerospace engineering or equivalent doctorate, or at least 12 years of relevant senior industry leadership experience. Appointments follow department needs; August 14 review has passed, final cutoff July 28, 2027.

after.department: School of Global Policy and Strategy — Institute on Global Conflict and Cooperation
after.title: Postdoctoral Scholar, Technology and International Security (IGCC)
after.summary: Up to six technology and international security fellowships, including AI and cyber research, based in residence in Washington, DC for 2027–29 (12-month participation also considered); computer science and other doctorates/ABD candidates are eligible, with PhD expected by September 1, 2027. Full consideration November 1, 2026; final cutoff August 24, 2027.

after.title: Moore Postdoctoral Fellowship
after.summary: Two-year postdoc in scientific machine learning and reduced-order ocean state estimation, potentially renewable; requires an engineering, oceanography or related doctorate, relevant data-driven/ML background and numerical fluid dynamics or ocean-model experience. The live ad retains a Spring/Summer 2026 intended start; August 28 review has passed, final cutoff February 1, 2027.

after.title: Postdoctoral Scholar
after.summary: Multiple Morimoto Lab postdocs developing autonomous soft, tip-extending robots for stroke treatment, including design, planning, controls and integration. Requires a mechanical engineering or related PhD with a strong robotics publication record; August 12 review has passed, final cutoff December 31, 2026.
